workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_training_plumbing: bounded Stage A profile train-loop smoke

workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: training plumbing smoke only; no promotion private-holdout driver-performance recurrent-belief profile-superiority or paper-result claim
stop_condition: stop if any Stage A profile fails to complete
stop if L0 mask metadata is missing from training artifacts
stop if any run produces non-finite metrics
stop if smoke runtime exceeds the resource cap

if L2_window_25 fails due shape or memory, route to finite-window resource audit
if L3 fails due recurrent sequence handling, route to recurrent training integration repair
if all pass, route to Stage B full generated profile smoke design or run
